Monsoon Session of Indian Parliament to Begin on July 20

The monsoon session of the Indian Parliament is expected to begin on July 20, with a possible duration of three weeks. This marks an important milestone in the country's legislative calendar. The session will be crucial for discussing key policies and bills, including the 'One Nation, One Election' bill. As the summer season brings heavy rainfall, the government has announced plans to ensure smooth functioning of the parliament during this period.
